title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-jordan-2026-03-04
content:
Console / Observability — triage scratchpad (quick notes)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Jordan Lee
Context: daily personal scratchpad for triaging incoming dashboard bugs and customer-reported issues. Mostly raw notes + next-action TODOs.

---
Open items summary (top of mind)
1) Customer: AcmeRetail — slow dashboard tile load & metric staleness (reported via CS on 2026-03-03). Ticket: JIRA-3421.
   - Symptoms: dashboard tiles for 'request latency (p95)' showing stale values for ~30–60m during 02:00-02:45 UTC. Some tiles blank ("no data").
   - Impact: customer-facing analytics panels display older values, affects sales demo. Severity: high for customer but system health not fully degraded.
   - First pass triage: checked metrics ingestion pipeline (ingest-pipeline-01) — small backlog spike at 02:05 UTC, consumer lag ~4m then cleared. No obvious GC/ooms on pipeline pods.
   - Dashboards: observed that the tile uses composite query (rollup + live) — possible query timeout when rollup datastore (clickhouse) returned slowly.
   - Next actions:
     * Maya to get clickhouse query logs for 02:00-03:00 UTC (assigned) — asked in #obs-triage (thread ts:1623421).
     * I will review grafana datasource timeouts and frontend logs (console-frontend) for errors (500/504) — TODO by EOD.
     * CS follow-up: send interim note to AcmeRetail saying we’re investigating and will provide update in 2 hours. (Priya on CS)

2) Internal bug: dashboard annotation toggle resets on refresh — JIRA-3470
   - Repro: toggle annotations off, refresh page, toggle state returns to default (on). Happens intermittently in Chrome 114 and Safari.
   - Suspect: frontend state hydration issue after new route load; maybe localStorage key overwritten by new feature (feature-annotation-v2).
   - Quick repro steps saved in reproduction.md (link above).
   - Next: pair with Chris to add failing E2E test; blocking ETA: 2 days. Add flaky tag and try to repro in headless CI.

3) Alert noise: high volume of `kv-cache-misses` alerts after deployment 2026-03-02
   - Observed ~2000 alerts over 6h window, many autoclosed, but increases paging and noise.
   - Root guess: rollout changed cache key format (PR 219) — causes effective cache miss rate spike until warm-up.
   - Action: add temporary suppression (silence) for non-customer-facing alerts for next 12h; long-term: add rollout-metadata annotation to alerts to suppress during warmup.
   - Responsible: ops-oncall to set silence; I will open follow-up ticket for alert improvements.

---
Notes to self / quick checklist
- [ ] Pull query logs from clickhouse for AcmeRetail window (Maya asked)
- [ ] Check console-frontend logs for 500/504 and stack traces (grep for "tile" + "timeout")
- [ ] Draft reply to CS for AcmeRetail (short, include ETA)
- [ ] Add e2e test for annotation toggle (pair with Chris)
- [ ] Open follow-up ticket for alert suppression + rollout annotation
- [ ] Verify whether rollout PR 219 included cache-format changes (review diff)

---
Meeting notes (standup 2026-03-04, obs team)
- Maya: will fetch clickhouse logs + look for slow queries, also suspects CPU spikes on read-replicas.
- Aisha: investigating a separate customer who reported missing error traces in traces panel — likely sampler issue.
- Chris: will start on annotation toggle e2e and allocate 4h tomorrow.
- Jordan (me): frontend logs + coordinate CS message; will test repro on latest canary.

---
Customer follow-ups (quick draft snippets)
- To: Priya (CS)
  Subject: Update on dashboard tile staleness (AcmeRetail)
  Body: Hi Priya — quick update for AcmeRetail: we’ve identified intermittent slow queries to the rollup store that caused some tiles to show stale values between 02:00-02:45 UTC. Engineering is collecting query logs and frontend traces now; we expect a root-cause update in ~2 hours. Apologies for the disruption — will follow up with a concrete mitigation plan.

---
Repro steps / debug checklist (detailed)
1) Reproduce locally with stage data: load dashboard X -> filter to tenant acme_retail -> set time range 01:30-03:30 UTC -> refresh a few times -> observe tile load sequence in network tab. Capture failing requests (save HAR).
2) Backend: run clickhouse slow-query log for timeframe, look for queries > 2s, note query_id, run EXPLAIN where possible.
3) Infra: check kafka consumer offsets for ingest pipeline for tenant-specific topic; look at consumer lag and pod restarts.
4) Frontend: tail console-frontend logs (kubectl logs -f) filter by tile ID; enable debug flag if needed.

---
Random notes / stray ideas
- Consider adding a "last-successful-push" stamp on tiles to diagnose staleness quickly. Could be small frontend/templating change.
- For rollout-related cache warmup, add a short warmup-silence window documented in rollout playbook.
- Capture a mini-runbook for AcmeRetail: one-pager for CS on how to respond when metrics stale.

---
End of scratchpad.
(rough, messy — meant to be ephemeral; will prune and move stable items to confluence/tickets)
